suggestions.title: Allow tracking buy-ins before team assignments are made.
suggestions.body_md:
The buy-in tracking is a nice feature that further centralizes event hosting. We are running a draft a few days before the event start, but are having people pay their buy-ins as they sign up.
Although I can work around it by temporarily assigning everyone to a team, it would be nice to be able to track the buy ins before the draft and without temporary team assignments.

suggestions.title: Allow manual submissions through discord
suggestions.body_md: Just talking to some clans and it was brought up it will be harder to get people to go to the site to do manual submissions. If there is a way to do manual submissions through discord (if people /claim-rsn) then that makes that experience more seamless

suggestions.title: Tracking effort towards a drop
suggestions.body_md: Brondt -“ I was just talking with fazebook about this, and one idea i had was to have a secondary data point for each drop that helps track contribution. for example, oathplate pieces come from yama so yama kc would count as contribution towards that. the timing aspect of it is important to see if people aren't logging in”

suggestions.title: When downloading Droptracker,Ask for API connection and denote its the primary communication channel
suggestions.body_md: My clanmate completed two tobs during the event and didnt get credit using the webhook. He was unaware of needing API enabled.

suggestions.title: End-of-month "clan recap"
suggestions.body_md:
something like a monthly recap thingy?

sharing a example picture

would be cool to have something like this available, either as an auto-postable, or as a generatable output so the admin can "humanize" the data with context

suggestions.title: Hall of Fame syncing instructions in the footer
suggestions.body_md: Quick instructions at the bottom how to import times from your PoH.

suggestions.title: Being able to pin priority tasks
suggestions.body_md: Say you are a team captain and you want your team to tackle ToB. You can pin ToB as the top priority then also set a secondary task.

suggestions.title: First pass of things that stuck out to my while playing with the Event feature for the first time.
suggestions.body_md:
- Maggot Eggs are not listed as available drops
  - This may be compounded by the hold up with the plugin update and video capture.
- It would be nice to be able to type in a boss to quickly add their drops to an item list
- Wintertodt isn't listed as a valid NPC source for Dragon axe
  - Tempoross IS for dragon harpoon
- Pets cant be added in list tiles
- Point tasks seem to have a weird set of valid values.
  - https://i.imgur.com/qAfW22L.png

suggestions.title: Client takes Phosani's screenshots ~1 tick too soon
suggestions.body_md: Screenshots are taken prior to the chat message at Phosani's for some reason--which would be ideal for verification purposes

suggestions.title: Manual review of submission missing img.
suggestions.body_md: Also, manual submissions are not enabled, correct?

suggestions.title: Hide news message upon login
suggestions.body_md: We currently always see the "droptracker is looking for developers..." message. Allow for a setting to disable it
